title: Runs API becomes unauthenticated when the key environment variable is unset
reasoning: Every mutating and read route depends on verify_runs_api_key, but verify_runs_api_key returns successfully when neither WINDIE_RUNS_API_KEY nor WINDIE_DEMO_API_KEY is configured. That turns missing configuration into an allow-all mode for creating runs, polling worker assignments, ingesting events, controlling runs, and stopping all runs. For hosted VM run/control endpoints, a fail-open auth dependency is a concrete permission gap and makes deployment misconfiguration dangerous.
recommendation: Fail closed by default: require a configured runs API key for these routes, or gate unauthenticated mode behind an explicit local-development flag that cannot be enabled accidentally in hosted deployments. Add startup/config validation if the API is enabled but no key is configured.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for this feature, and the excerpts show no test coverage asserting the no-env-key behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add route-level tests that clear WINDIE_RUNS_API_KEY and WINDIE_DEMO_API_KEY and assert protected endpoints return an auth/config error, then set a key and assert missing or wrong x-windie-runs-key is rejected while the correct key succeeds.
minimumFixScope: support.py auth helper plus focused route tests for at least one read endpoint and one mutating endpoint.
